annotations.title: Pick beers off a venue's Untappd menu that a user hasn't had

description: Like untappd_menu_pick, but takes an Untappd venue (URL or id) instead of menu lines: it pulls the venue's FULL verified menu (walking every section page until complete, within api_budget), refreshes the user's distinct-beers cache (incremental, or an automatic backfill), checks every menu beer against it and ranks the not-had ones by global rating. Returns the same picks / not_had / had / sync shape plus a venue block (menu_complete is false only if the budget ran out mid-menu). A venue with no verified menu comes back unresolved — use untappd_menu_pick with the tap list instead. Omit username for your own account.

api_budget.description: Max Untappd API calls this run, shared by the cache sync, searches and rating lookups (default 60; Untappd allows ~100/hour). If it runs out, the result says another_run_needed and a re-run continues from what was cached.

style_filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the beer style or parent style for the picks (e.g. "ipa", "stout").

top_n.description: How many picks to return (default 2, max 10).

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).

venue.description: Untappd venue URL (https://untappd.com/v/<slug>/<id>) or numeric venue id.
